translation.title: Butenafine Hydrochloride Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for ringworm — including athlete's foot (tinea pedis), jock itch (tinea cruris, ringworm of the groin and inner thighs) and ringworm of the body (tinea corporis) — and for pityriasis versicolor.
translation.usage: Apply to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, or on severely eroded (raw, oozing) areas. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are hypersensitive to allylamine antifungals, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or for premature babies, newborns and children aged 12 or under. This medicine is for external use only. Be careful not to let it touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes. For athlete's foot, ringworm of the body and jock itch, apply enough of this medicine to cover the affected area and the surrounding skin. Before applying it, wash the affected area clean and dry it completely, and wash your hands after applying. Do not use an occlusive dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. Occasional local irritation, redness, erythema (red spots), itching, contact dermatitis, blisters, and rarely erosion, scaling or skin cracks may occur. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if irritation or sensitivity occurs from using this medicine.
